changelog: **A standing 1:1 can be set up from the relation page and reaches both people** (#2013, slice 2). `/mentor/mentees/[id]` gets a *Recurring 1:1* control (`src/components/meeting/RelationRecurringMeeting.tsx`, EN/TR/DE `oneToOneSeries`): days, time, length, every 1–8 weeks and an end (never / on a date / after N meetings), edit and stop — on the slice-1 `MeetingSeries.relationId` rule, never rows (#1110). Everything a project call already did now covers a relation series too: the mentee is invited when it is set up (`announceNextOccurrence` returned early for anything without a project), the upcoming-meeting banner shows it to both (`src/lib/upcomingMeeting.ts`), either of them can mark an occurrence over (`/api/meetings/[id]/end`), the reminder cron reminds both — each naming the other person and linking their own calendar, with its own EN/TR/DE heading — and only while the pairing is ACTIVE, and the Google Calendar mirror's audience is the relation's two people (`audienceOf()`), withdrawn once the pairing completes. New named cron job `GET /api/cron?job=meeting-series-reminders` (admin; the same idempotent function the batch runs). e2e: `e2e/relation-series-reach.spec.ts` (invite, both reminders with the other's name and own calendar link, claimed once, banner for both, the mentee ends an occurrence, a completed pairing reminds nobody; the UI create/stop flow) and a relation case in `e2e/google-calendar-series.spec.ts` (two events, `INTERVAL=2`, withdrawn on completion).

en: You can now turn a 1:1 into a recurring meeting — every week or every few weeks, open-ended, until a date or for a set number of meetings. Both of you get it on your calendar, with reminders the day before and an hour before.
tr: Artık birebir görüşmeyi tekrarlayan bir toplantıya dönüştürebilirsiniz: her hafta ya da birkaç haftada bir, süresiz, belirli bir tarihe kadar veya belirli sayıda görüşme için. Toplantı ikinizin de takvimine düşer ve bir gün ile bir saat önce hatırlatma gelir.
de: Ein Einzelgespräch lässt sich jetzt als wiederkehrender Termin anlegen: jede Woche oder alle paar Wochen, unbefristet, bis zu einem Datum oder für eine feste Anzahl Termine. Der Termin steht in beiden Kalendern, mit Erinnerungen am Vortag und eine Stunde vorher.
